methods.name: DUALIZE
methods.outcome: positive factorization yields a coefficientwise compound-Poisson majorant with primitive profile C_r<=b_r

methods.name: DO ONE SCALE ONE DIRECTION AT A TIME
methods.outcome: proved a banded primitive-activity theorem in which noise pays q^(kD) against activity in the kth degree band

methods.name: ATTACK THE NEGATION FIRST
methods.outcome: independent parity blocks show q^(D+1) H_D is an essentially sharp obstruction scale and sharpen the structural diagnosis of Mao

new_core_results: For any positive factorization F=prod_l(1+sum_r c_{l,r}z^r), with C_r=sum_l c_{l,r} and H_D=sum_{r>D}C_r, 1+chi2(T_sqrt(q)P||Q)<=exp(q Adv^{<=D}(P,Q)^2+q^{D+1}H_D).
If D_n=(log n)^{1+Omega(1)}, bounded LDA and log^+ H_{n,D_n}=o(D_n), then every fixed q<1 gives uniformly bounded full noised chi-square and a uniform TV gap against all measurable tests.
Band refinement: high primitive activity H_k^(D) in degrees (kD,(k+1)D] contributes at most q^(kD+1) H_k^(D) to log F(q).
Independent parity blocks of degree D+1 have zero LDA through D and become strongly distinguishable when the noise-scaled primitive activity ma q^(D+1) diverges, establishing near-sharpness.

For Mao's zero-LDA family and every positive factorization of its spectral-energy polynomial, q^(D_n+1) H_{n,D_n}->infinity at every fixed surviving-noise q; hence the high primitive activity is necessarily superpolynomial at the source scale.

Heterogeneous tensor-product planted/null pairs give an exact product factorization of spectral-energy polynomials and satisfy the robust criterion whenever the number of blocks and individual block chi-square divergences are polynomially bounded.
